Fractional CFO & Advisory Services for SMBs

Your CFO. Your Strategy. Your Growth.

Do You Have the Financial Leadership to Support Your Growth?

As your business grows, financial decisions become more complex. Revenue, cash flow, profitability, forecasting, and growth plans all require a clearer financial perspective. A CFO helps leadership understand what the numbers are telling them, plan ahead, and make informed decisions with greater confidence.

That's where a Fractional CFO steps in. We provide the high-level financial strategy you need to scale safely, without the $500k+ salary of a full-time hire.

"Fresh FP&A completely transformed how we view our margins. We finally have a roadmap."

— CEO, SaaS Startup

More Than a CFO. A Strategic Partner.

Financial Leadership, FP&A & Strategy Planning

Turn Financial Complexity Into Clarity

The Shift: Full-Time CFO vs. Fractional CFO

We’re not consultants. We turn financial complexity into clarity, achieve 95%+ forecast accuracy, and give you decision-ready insights so you can stay ahead of your growth.

Full-Time CFO

  • $250k–$500k+ salary & benefits per year
  • 3–6 months ramp-up before delivering value
  • Single-industry experience
  • Fixed headcount, hard to downscale
  • Internal perspective only
  • Long-term employment contract

Fractional CFO

  • Fraction of the cost, flexible engagement
  • Immediate impact from day one
  • Senior CFO expertise across multiple industries
  • Scale up or down as the business evolves
  • Broad market insight & external perspective
  • Month-to-month or project-based

Financial Leadership, FP&A & Strategy Planning

The Shift: Accounting vs. FP&A

Accounting tells you where you've been. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) tells you where you are going, and how to get there faster.

Traditional Accounting

  • Backward-looking
  • Focuses on compliance & taxes
  • Tells you what happened
  • Static spreadsheets

Modern FP&A

  • Forward-looking predictions
  • Focuses on strategy & growth
  • Tells you what *will* happen
  • Dynamic scenario modeling

Our FP&A Deliverables

Rolling Forecasts

Dynamic 12-month projections updated continuously as actuals come in, keeping you agile.

KPI Dashboards

Visual, real-time tracking of the non-financial metrics that drive your financial success.

Budget Variance

Deep-dive reporting on exactly where and why operations deviated from the plan.

Unit Economics

CAC, LTV, and precise margin analysis at the individual product or customer level.

Capacity Planning

Models to determine exactly when you need to hire, expand facilities, or buy inventory.

Cash Flow Modeling

Advanced liquidity tracking to ensure you never face unexpected cash crunches.

Board Reporting

Professional, comprehensive financial decks tailored for investors and stakeholders.

Dept. Budgeting

Collaborative budget creation that holds individual department heads accountable.

Business Growth, Expansion & Exit Planning

Begin With The End In Mind

Whether you are planning to scale, enter a new market, raise capital, or eventually exit, the right financial strategy helps you prepare for what comes next.

Strategic Growth Planning

We help you build a financial strategy that supports sustainable, long-term growth without over-leveraging your current operations.

  • Funding requirement analysis
  • Margin optimization for scale
  • Infrastructure investment timing

Expansion & Scale

Understand the precise financial requirements and risks of entering new geographic markets or expanding your core operations.

  • New market ROI modeling
  • Break-even analysis for expansion
  • Competitor financial benchmarking

M&A Support

Evaluate potential acquisitions using rigorous financial analysis to ensure they add genuine enterprise value.

  • Target company due diligence
  • Post-merger integration modeling
  • Synergy realization tracking

Exit Readiness

Prepare your business financially for a successful transition, maximizing your valuation when it's time to sell.

  • Quality of Earnings (QoE) prep
  • EBITDA normalization
  • Clean historical financial data
